mandate: Response-Based Controllability Identification: does response magnitude C_t=||J_u(t)|| contain usable controllability information about achievable intervention gain G_t? Mechanism validation, NOT an optimization algorithm experiment.
hypothesis: States with larger finite-time controllability proxy C_t achieve larger best-intervention gain G_t = L_baseline - min(L_LR+, L_LR-); and response sign predicts the useful action direction.

D1.note: fully offline; h_eta (analytic dL/du) and rollout losses from the SAME cell record; LR pulse persistent u=log(eta/eta0), delta=0.05 (frozen a0o)

D2.source: outputs/a0q_response_control_map_v01/runs/cells.jsonl (FROZEN, read-only) for chi_lr/chi_clip/chi_wd + NEW GPU rollouts by a0s_run_v01.py
D2.new_rollouts: per cell: baseline u=0 twice (CRN bitwise) + LR +/- delta persistent H=4 via FROZEN import-only a0q.run_channel_rollout; NO analytic recompute (chi values taken from frozen A0Q records)
D2.note: A0Q never stored rollout losses; D2 rollouts replicate the frozen A0Q FD branch exactly

definitions.predicted_action: +delta if chi_lr < 0 else -delta (response sign; chi=dL/du, du=+delta lowers loss when chi<0)

stats: OLS G=alpha+beta*C: beta, 95% CI (t-dist, n-2 df), p-value
leave-one-seed-out (3 folds): fit on 2 seeds, predict held-out seed; per-fold Pearson, pooled R2 and MAE
A0S-1_magnitude.gate: PASS iff Spearman rho > 0 with p < 0.05 AND LOSO pooled Pearson > 0

A0S-2_direction.gate: PASS iff accuracy > 0.5 with binomial p < 0.05 (per dataset)

stats: per-channel share of C_J (median across cells)
leave-one-seed-out CV (3 folds) MSE and R2 comparison
A0S-3_matrix.gate: clip improves prediction iff Model B LOSO-MSE < Model A LOSO-MSE

verdict_rules.PASS: A0S-1 gate PASS AND A0S-2 gate PASS on both datasets
verdict_rules.FAIL_case_1: A0S-1 gate FAIL: causal response is a dynamical property, not optimization utility; need richer state representation
verdict_rules.FAIL_case_2: short-term (H=4) controllability may PASS while long-horizon gain is NOT tested here; A0P already showed no stable temporal decay kernel, so short-term G must not be read as long-term training improvement; report must state this explicitly

forbidden: redefine delta (must stay 0.05 from frozen a0o) or H (must stay 4)
edit any frozen A0O/A0Q artifact or module
stop_rule: STOP after A0S. Do not auto-launch any next round.
